subject.title: fix: deliver background task completions through owning sessions

question: Should this PR wait for redacted Telegram/gateway proof before merge, or should maintainers explicitly accept source-level proof only after the classifier fix?
rationale: The changed behavior is user-visible Telegram/topic delivery, and tests do not prove the real transport/session path that the PR is intended to fix.

options.title: Require Live Delivery Proof
options.body: Fix the classifier blocker and require redacted Telegram Desktop, gateway-log, terminal/live-output, or linked-artifact proof before merge.

options.title: Accept Source-Only Risk
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally merge after the code fix with source and regression-test evidence only, while owning the real transport/session delivery risk.

options.title: Pause For Broader Contract
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want one canonical detached-work liveness and terminal-delivery contract before landing partial owner-session routing.

recommendation.title: Require Live Delivery Proof
recommendation.body: Fix the classifier blocker and require redacted Telegram Desktop, gateway-log, terminal/live-output, or linked-artifact proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest adjacent history across heartbeat and subagent delivery boundaries involved in the proof decision.
